description: This file is a shell script that defines a test suite for verifying the behavior of 'git status' with untracked cache functionality. It includes setup steps, various tests for cache invalidation, sparse checkout, subdirectory handling, symlinks, and file replacements, and checks for cache persistence across operations.

methods.name: sync_mtime
methods.description: Synchronizes the modification times of directories to ensure cache correctness.

methods.name: avoid_racy
methods.description: Introduces a delay to prevent race conditions in filesystem timestamp updates.

methods.name: status_is_clean
methods.description: Checks that the current git working directory status is clean.
